metadata.scope: All tracked regular/symlink blob entries at baseline. Worktree edits, ignored build outputs, expanded macros and external dependency source excluded.
metadata.units: bytes, physical text lines, nonblank text lines (comments included); binary line count is zero
metadata.mixed_policy: Files with cfg(test) are reported as production-mixed-tests. Pure-production and mixed-file totals remain separate.
metadata.generated_policy: Reviewed generator/output map plus first-eight-line markers; unmarked outputs may remain unrecognized. Macro expansions are excluded.
metadata.classification_policy: Deterministic path-based attribution; unresolved records remain visible. Responsibility is independently recorded from role.
